mapper.select: select id, dept_id as deptId, report_id as reportId, name, model, accuracy, location, calibration_frequency as calibrationFrequency, measurement_range as measurementRange, data_origin as dataOrigin, source_table as sourceTable, source_id as sourceId, sort_order as sortOrder from report_monitoring_device where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId} order by sort_order, id
mapper.delete: delete from report_monitoring_device where report_id = #{reportId} and dept_id = #{deptId}
mapper.insert: insert into report_monitoring_device ( dept_id, report_id, name, model, accuracy, location, calibration_frequency, measurement_range, data_origin, source_table, source_id, sort_order, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time ) values ( #{deptId}, #{reportId}, #{name}, #{model}, #{accuracy}, #{location}, #{calibrationFrequency}, #{measurementRange}, #{dataOrigin}, #{sourceTable}, #{sourceId}, #{sortOrder}, #{createBy}, now(), #{updateBy}, now() )
